releaseNotes: PDF Stage 1 reliability test: Smart Search is still limited to PDFs only and now checks exactly one PDF at a time with OCR completely disabled. Searchable PDF text is saved immediately. Scanned/image PDFs are checkpointed for the next OCR stage without attempting OCR yet. Malformed, encrypted, or unreadable PDFs are isolated per file and cannot stop the remaining PDFs. The Stage 1 progress runs through the full PDF list, reports searchable/scanned/failed counts, and uses a fresh local PDF index. Images remain excluded while the PDF pipeline is validated.
